text: Template v3 landed at d8f7a2c and the echo agent rebuilt from it at c19a17e (meta_agent/builds/echo/0002, parent build-echo-0001; 0001 untouched). v3 carries three session skills: run-skill, the only one that names a script under src/ (src/run_skill.py), with library/index.md and one page per library skill rendered by the build from each manifest; classify-knowledge and choose-session-level, adapted from yours, naming no path outside the bundle. The bundle's CLAUDE.md names the three and carries the rules they repeat; the trigger sentence per library skill stays (B8). Read off runs: validate.py --bundle on builds/echo/0002/bundle printed VERDICT PASS mode=bundle failed=0 with B15 among the checks; bundle_problems printed []; check 24 says nothing about the template's three skills; the gate printed 0 failed. What does not fit, each yours to take up or to put to the person: (1) a bundle holds no copy of the grade table, the claim kinds or the unit registry, so the bundle's classify-knowledge names none: it says a grade that is not already on a number is reported as not derived, and a unit is converted by a library skill only. I think a bundle should carry those three files, since its CLAUDE.md asks for a grade on every number it reports; which files and where is a contract. (2) the build writes no model into a subagent's file under .claude/agents/: the specification's drawing has no field for one, so choose-session-level in a bundle tells the session how to choose for the call or to ask the person. Whether the drawing carries a level per subagent is a schema question and a cost. (3) spec_a1 of a request names the build's directory (builds/echo/0001/bundle), so a rebuild under a new id leaves the boundary axis naming the first build; designer --rebuild writes no request card and says this in the build card's note. Whether an axis should name a build's directory is the specification's design. (4) B15 does not ask that a page agrees with its manifest; the page is what bundle.skill_page(ref, manifest) returns and a meta test asserts that, so the check is a test and not a gate. (5) .claude/skills/specify-and-build/SKILL.md still says the session skill is designed in tasks/015 and comes with the template version that carries it, and names no way to rebuild: the command is python -m meta_agent.src.designer --rebuild meta_agent/requests/<rid> --seat <seat>. (6) Not done by this seat: the card's done-when that a fresh session in the bundle handles its replay item through the session skill; it needs a session opened in the bundle's folder. Also read again for the card: arithmetic under meta_agent/src, templates apart, is in parameters/bounds.py (propagation and rounding of uncertainty) and in cases/recall.py (weight_of, a ranking weight for recall, no physical quantity).
